declarations.name: AuiBottomSheet
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Bottom Sheet; the projected content is the body:
`<aui-bottom-sheet title="Share" [(open)]="sharing">...</aui-bottom-sheet>`.
`modal` is read once at creation (init-only).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accessible name, rendered as the heading (text only). Must be non-empty after trimming.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Referenced by aria-describedby (text only). Hidden when empty.

inputs.name: snapPoints
inputs.description: Heights as fractions of the viewport height, strictly ascending, each in (0, 1]. Without snap points the sheet fits its content (capped at 90dvh). Two or more make the handle a slider.

inputs.name: snap
inputs.description: Index into snapPoints used when the sheet opens (0 = lowest). Must be 0 without snap points. When set, open() re-applies it.

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description: true: showModal() with inert background, backdrop and scroll lock. false: show(); the page stays interactive (supplementary panels only).

inputs.name: closeOnEscape
inputs.description: Escape requests close (cancelable, reason 'escape') when the sheet is the topmost overlay.

inputs.name: closeOnBackdrop
inputs.description: Backdrop click requests close (cancelable, reason 'backdrop'). Modal only.

inputs.name: closeOnDragDown
inputs.description: Dragging the handle down past min(120px, 25% of the lowest height) requests close (cancelable, reason 'drag').

models.name: open
models.description: Whether the bottom sheet is shown: `[(open)]`. Closing by Escape, the close button, or an action sets it to false.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open (a dismissing drag snaps back).

outputs.name: snapChange
outputs.description: The user picked a height (snap point index).

methods.name: snapTo
methods.description: Move to a snap point (index into `snapPoints`).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) pattern implemented with native <dialog>.showModal(); non-modal sheets use <dialog>.show(). With two or more snap points the drag handle follows the APG Slider pattern.

limitations: Non-modal sheets are not in the top layer; they use z-index 1000 and can be covered by page content with a higher stacking context.
Only the handle strip starts a drag; the body scrolls and never drags the sheet.
Snap points are fractions of the viewport height, not pixel heights or content-based heights.
Slide animations need @starting-style and transition-behavior: allow-discrete; older browsers open and close without animation.
Initial focus follows the native dialog focusing steps: the first focusable element, which is the close button when shown (it precedes the handle in DOM order although the handle is shown first).
open() re-applies the `snap` option when it is set, so a height the user chose is not kept across reopening in that case.
A <form method="dialog"> submit inside the content closes with reason 'programmatic'.
